text:
sophie: Kickoff — VP Demo webinar on 2026-05-12 10am PT. Need volunteer to create registration page, set Zoom, and wire replay -> HubSpot + S3 + YouTube. Who owns? :calendar:

mike: I can do Zoom config and co-hosting. Need clarification on recording retention and auto-transcript.

ana: I'll build the registration page in HubSpot. Which form fields? minimal: email, company, role, use case. Add utm_source, utm_campaign hidden fields.

jess: I'll own post-event followup email + replay page. Template in a sec.

mike: Zoom settings I'll enable: Require registration, Enable cloud recording (audio/video+share), Auto-transcript, Record active speaker + gallery, Allow alternative hosts: @mike, @sophie. Waiting room? Set to enabled until 5 min prior (to avoid waiting room trouble).

sophie: Good. Add passcode? We had issues last time. Let's require registration so passcode not necessary. Enable unique join links.

ana: Form fields list:
- email
- first_name
- last_name
- company
- role
- use_case (dropdown: "PoC/Prod/Research")
Hidden fields: utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, content_id

mike: Zapier mapping to HubSpot: map email->email, first_name->firstname, company->company, role->jobtitle, use_case->hs_custom_use_case, utm_* -> campaign fields. I'll post the Zap JSON.

mike: ```
Zap trigger: Zoom registration
Action: Create/Update Contact in HubSpot
Properties: email, firstname, lastname, company, jobtitle, hs_marketing_consent=true
Custom: hs_webinar_source = utm_source
``` 

jess: Post-event flow: 1) Wait 5 minutes after end, 2) Cloud recording processes -> S3 via ops-bot lambda, 3) Generate transcript (auto-transcript OK), 4) Publish replay page and send follow-up email with CTA + short TL;DR + embed. Tag lead with 'webinar_vp_demo_may12'.

ops-bot: Note: S3 upload currently puts files at s3://redwood-webinars/2026/05/vp-demo-1768945600/

sophie: We need gating: only registrants get replay link for 14 days, then make public. Also send to internal slack channel #marketing when recording is ready.

ana: I'll add hidden field 'consent_replay' copy of marketing consent to fulfill privacy.

mike: Zoom settings to confirm:
- registration required: yes
- auto approve: auto-approve for conversion
- alternative hosts: mike@redwood.com, sophie@redwood.com
- co-hosts: jess

sophie: Can someone test end-to-end by Friday? @mike @ana @jess

mike: I'll run a dry-run Thurs 4pm PT. Posting test creds in #eng-private.

jess: Draft follow-up subject: "Thanks for joining – VP Demo replay + resources" body snippet:
```html
Hi {{first_name}},

Thanks for joining the VP Demo. Replay: <link>

Key takeaways:
1) latency/cost demo
2) rollout tips
3) Q&A

Schedule a 20-min follow-up: <calendly link>
``` 

sophie: Perfect. Who will handle captions? Auto-transcript ok but we want human-edited SRT. ops-bot can queue for vendor.

ops-bot: Vendor queue: caption-service (turnaround 24-48h). Will add job when S3 upload completes.

ana: For registration page link use domain events.redwood.com/vp-demo-may12, redirect with UTM params.

jess: Also create a short LinkedIn event and add signup link.

sophie: Great. I'll make a checklist and ping again after Mike's dry-run.

mike: Done — test scheduled. :thumbsup: 

sophie: Thanks team! :party_parrot:
